raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Update the GB300 disaggregated AgentX commands from [InferenceX #4303](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4303) at `a0e5be74248f09552f88904f90dc71e8f190a3e9`: 3/5/8 DEP2 prefill workers plus DEP16 decode, using the digest-pinned October 21 nightly and Mooncake external linking.

Reserve a separate two-port KV-event range for each colocated DEP2 prefill worker, matching SGLang’s per-DP-rank port offsets. Keep GPU/port isolation for colocated prefill workers and mark the configurations verified in the PR, with a link to the successful full sweep and evaluation. Remove duplicate explanatory prose; existing aggregated and other-hardware configurations stay unchanged.

Publish KV events on prefill only; round-robin decode omits the KV-event publisher. Metrics remain enabled on both roles.

Validation: the [complete InferenceX sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39695060576) passed all seven performance points and five evaluation jobs. All six disaggregated role configurations, frontend settings and explicit Mooncake master arguments match InferenceX #4303 after deployment substitutions; 19 unrelated configurations are unchanged. Cookbook configuration checks, full repository pre-commit checks, Mintlify build validation and link checks pass.
